answer: An hostile operator running 66 aliases therefore needs 162 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are published in onyx, expire in terrace, and lantern lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4347 identities would post 2545 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
